title: {p} and {v} Quinoa Skillet
steps: Cut the {p} into 1-inch pieces, season with salt and pepper, and cook in a hot oiled skillet until {doneness}. Move to a plate.
Cook the {v} in the same pan for 3 to 4 minutes until softened, then stir in the {spice} for a minute.
Add the {s} and the {sauce}, bring to a boil, then cover and simmer on low about 15 minutes, until most of the liquid is absorbed.
Return the {p}, cover, and cook 5 more minutes until everything is tender and the liquid is gone.
Finish with a squeeze of lemon and serve from the pan.
tip: Pile in extra vegetables. They steam on top of the quinoa, and the pan stays one-dish.
